full_judgment: 20. The learned Family Appellate Judge in considering Exhibit -'ka' came to the decision that the respondent (plaintiff) was not only unwilling and incapable of maintaining and nursing the babies who were only one year of age at that time but also disclaimed voluntarily the right of custody and she being a highly educated Government Officer had waived her right to custody of infant children without any hesitation whatsoever. The Family Appellate Judge disqualified the plaintiff for her entitlement to the custody of the minor sons taking the view that she got no close relation such as mother and sister with her at the present residence who can nurse and look after the infant children particularly during the office time. The family appellate judge expressed the view that the minor two sons can be looked after properly and rightly under the care and custody of the appellant (defendant). The Family Appellate Judge does not appear to have adverted to the reasoned decisions on which Family Court's Judgment rested nor to have met the material findings arrived at by the Family Court Judge which has been extracted above. The Family Appellate Judge also failed to direct his mind to the rules of Muslim Law as to the entitlement of the custody of the minor sons and the judgment under challenge cannot be said to be of proper judgment of reversal.
